[CANDIDATE] | reality-check-003 | reality-check | INFO | reality-check | public/ | No screenshots subdirectory exists yet — NOT STARTED as planned | glob public/** returns only NHEB_Tinarith_CV.docx; no screenshots directory and no PNG assets anywhere under public | Screenshot pipeline starts from a clean slate matching plan expectations | HIGH
[CANDIDATE] | reality-check-004 | reality-check | INFO | reality-check | docs/SCREENSHOT_CHECKLIST.md | Checklist document does not exist — NOT STARTED as planned | repo-wide glob for SCREENSHOT_CHECKLIST.md returns zero files and docs/ contains no files at all | FR-006 deliverable must be authored from scratch; no stale version to reconcile | HIGH
[CANDIDATE] | reality-check-005 | reality-check | INFO | reality-check | vite.config.ts:14 | base configured exactly as expected via FIGMA_PUBLIC_URL ternary — ASSUMPTION CORRECT | line 14 reads base: process.env.FIGMA_PUBLIC_URL with appended trailing slash else '/'; Vite statically exposes the resolved base as import.meta.env.BASE_URL in client code, so base-aware asset paths are usable (full-URL base is carried through when FIGMA_PUBLIC_URL is set) | FR-004 base-path-safe screenshot URLs can be built from import.meta.env.BASE_URL | HIGH
[CANDIDATE] | reality-check-006 | reality-check | INFO | reality-check | src/index.css:5 | Tailwind v4 @theme tokens present and no conflicting layout-scale rules — ALREADY COMPLETE | @theme block lines 5-13 defines --color-purple-600 #7C3AED, --color-purple-700, --color-purple-50, --color-lavender #F0EDFF, --color-indigo-950 #1E1B4B plus Poppins/JetBrains Mono font tokens; remaining CSS is box-sizing, smooth scroll, body typography, scrollbar and selection styling only — no max-width or padding rules | Wider-container overhaul faces no CSS-level resistance; purple/lavender/indigo palette already tokenized | HIGH
[CANDIDATE] | reality-check-007 | reality-check | INFO | reality-check | .swarm/spec.md:9 | Spec exists with Recorded Baseline plus FR-001..FR-008 and SC-001..SC-008 — ALREADY COMPLETE | Recorded Baseline section at line 9 mirrors observed App.tsx values (1152px container, py-20, pt-28, h-48, p-5); FR-001 through FR-008 span lines 18-51 including the FR-004 screenshot filename table; SC-001 through SC-008 span lines 55-62 | Plan document is consistent with on-disk reality; no spec drift detected | HIGH
[CANDIDATE] | reality-check-008 | reality-check | LOW | integration | src/App.tsx:242 | Existing resume link uses root-absolute href that ignores configured base — relevant to FR-004 base-path requirement | Hero CV anchor uses href="/NHEB_Tinarith_CV.docx" while vite.config.ts line 14 can set a prefixed base from FIGMA_PUBLIC_URL; a root-absolute string breaks under non-root deployment | The same base-awareness pattern required for new screenshot URLs should be applied to this existing asset link during the overhaul | HIGH

REALITY CHECK: 6 references verified, 0 discrepancies found.
  ✓ ALREADY COMPLETE src/App.tsx — all baseline classes present (max-w-6xl ×9, py-20 ×6, pt-28, text-4xl md:text-5xl, h-48 md:h-full, p-5); projects array = exactly 6 entries, every image field an images.unsplash.com URL
  ✓ ASSUMPTION CORRECT public/ — contains only NHEB_Tinarith_CV.docx; no screenshots/ subdirectory (NOT STARTED)
  ✓ NOT STARTED docs/SCREENSHOT_CHECKLIST.md — file absent; docs/ has no files at all
  ✓ ASSUMPTION CORRECT vite.config.ts — base at line 14 via FIGMA_PUBLIC_URL ternary ('/' fallback); import.meta.env.BASE_URL usable for base-aware asset paths
  ✓ ALREADY COMPLETE src/index.css — @theme defines purple-600/700/50, lavender, indigo-950; no layout-scale rules that would resist wider containers
  ✓ ALREADY COMPLETE .swarm/spec.md — Recorded Baseline + FR-001..FR-008 + SC-001..SC-008 all present and consistent with observed code

Notes: the filesystem list_directory tool failed with an infrastructure schema-validation error (unsupported draft-07 dialect), so public/ contents were verified via glob instead — read-only workaround, nothing modified. One bonus observation (reality-check-008): the hardcoded `/NHEB_Tinarith_CV.docx` resume href is not base-aware and will break under a prefixed deployment base, the same class of issue FR-004 targets for screenshots.
